text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- National Assembly Speaker Saadoun Hammadi meets Arab ambassadors in Moscow.
- Zionists print picture to tarnish reputation of Virgin Mary.
- Preparations under way to mark the 17 July revolution.
- Iraq and Jordan review scientific cooperation.
- Article spells out means to be used by the United States in the 21st century to control the world.
- Article on the aims behind the Turkish invasion of northern Iraq.
- International firms express readiness to airlift supplies to Iraq.
- Russia to demand lifting of oil ban on Iraq in October.
